commit.message:
docs(adr): renumber MCP ADRs 0004/0005 → 0006/0007 (resolve collision)

The main merge brought two Proposed MCP ADRs numbered 0004/0005, colliding with
the Accepted engine ADRs of the same numbers (0004 full-codec-engine, 0005
semantic-model-interface-currency). The Accepted engine ADRs keep their numbers;
renumber the MCP ADRs to 0006/0007 and update all cross-references (titles, the
ADR index, PED_MCP_CAPABILITIES.md, PROPOSAL_mcp_backend.md).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
